Export waits for it): vCard 2.1 / 3.0 / 4.0, folded lines, Apple `itemN.` groups set aside, TYPE as list / quoted / bare, TEL as `tel:` URI, BDAY / ANNIVERSARY / X-ANNIVERSARY as `YYYY-MM-DD`, `YYYYMMDD`, `--MM-DD` or `--MMDD`, ADR post office box and extended address put in front of the street (nothing lost), escaped `;` / `,` respected inside values and our `X-LABEL`, PHOTO never read (CT-NP); `parse` reports `cut` (a value longer than Contacts keeps, an unreadable date, a year outside 1850–2200), `fold` at 75 octets. `contacts/dav.js` (`window.OrosContactsDav.mapper(colUrl, { mark, now })`, pure, same test file): the item is the contact's own fields plus `cats` (label names); `read` (a group card, `KIND:group` / `X-ADDRESSBOOKSERVER-KIND:group` → null; `ro` when `cut` or more than one card), `write` (no raw → `VERSION:3.0`, `UID:<id>@oros.contacts`; with raw → DAV-4 per property group: N+FN, NICKNAME, ORG (units kept), TITLE, TEL, EMAIL, ADR, URL, IMPP, BDAY+ANNIVERSARY+X-ANNIVERSARY+X-EVENT, NOTE, CATEGORIES, X-OROS-STARRED, X-OROS-AVATAR are replaced only when their value changed, and a line whose value is still there is kept verbatim with its parameters and group; N keeps its prefix / suffix; REV is set; vCard 4 cards get vCard 4 date and type forms; PHOTO (DAV-5), UID, X-* and the rest stay), `hash` (the sanitizeContact projection, spacing and control characters as a write leaves them; labels by key: the three seed labels by id in any language (`SEEDS`: Personal / Προσωπικό / Privat …), others by name without case or accents), `idFor` (own UID → id, else `dav-` + hash(collection + UID)), `copy` (" (conflict)" on the given name, else family, company, nickname), `merge` (the first link: one-value fields keep the one here when it has one, lists are joined without repeats, one birthday and one anniversary, notes joined, labels joined, starred if either). `davsync.js` gains two optional hooks used only by Contacts: `local.match(item)` (an id here for a server item seen for the first time; Contacts: `cdMatch`, a shared e-mail or phone, names agreeing or one empty, exactly one candidate) and `map.merge(here, there)` (with no base and both differing, the joined item goes to both sides: `stats.merged`; a join that cannot be written exactly stays joined here and the server keeps its own until either changes). The Calendar does not pass them, so its behaviour is unchanged. Contacts: `state.dav` `{ url, mtime }` in the synced blob (newer wins, equal → larger url, unlink = `url ""`, absent until a first link; `mergeContacts` keeps it, `setFromSync` adopts it). Top bar `Server (CardDAV)` (`#ct-dav`) → `#cd-dlg`: no account → pointer to Settings › Sync; else the account's address books, the linked one with status, Sync now, Unlink and held deletions, the others with Link (only while nothing is linked) and a first-link preview ("N to download, M to upload, K already here, J joined"). Passes as in the Calendar (1.5 s after open, 5 min, visible again, online, 4 s after `saveState` but not after its own apply, after an orOS pull, Sync now). `cdApply` writes the server's fields into the contact and keeps relations, keep in touch, the log; label names → ids (seed by id, then by folded name, else a new label); `saveState` stamps the changed fields (CT-PF), removals leave tombstones. Read-only contacts (`cdRo`): the edit window shows `ct.dav.ro` and no Save. State record key `card|<url>`, `{ link: the link's mtime, st }` as in W3. Tests `tests/davsync-contacts.test.js` (two devices, one fake CardDAV server: first-link join keeps PHOTO and X- lines, no-op passes write nothing with Greek-named seed labels against English categories, second device binds and writes nothing, DAV-1 / DAV-2 / DAV-3 held and restore).

New codes `cd-notnc`, `cd-login-expired`, `cd-cancelled`. Settings card: `Sign in with Nextcloud` (the window opens on the click), the background switch and one status line per app (synced at / did not finish / deletions waiting). Server guides (Nextcloud, Radicale, Baïkal, mailbox.org, Fastmail, iCloud) in the Settings help, section "Your own calendar and contacts server" (EN / EL / DE). CI: quality.yml job `radicale` starts Radicale 3 (auth none, storage in RUNNER_TEMP) and runs `.github/qa/radicale.js`: davkit discovery + probe, then the Calendar, To-Do and Contacts mappers through `davsync.js` (preview, up, down, a change by another client, DAV-6 quiet pass, patch keeps an `X-` line, a second device binds with no writes, both changed → "(conflict)" copy, deletions both ways). Tests `tests/davkit-nc.test.js`.
- **WebDAV W3 client (2026-10-17).** (1) `conf.relay` (Settings checkbox "Through the orOS relay", opt-in only, disclosure that the app password passes through): `davReq` sends to `DAV_RELAY` (`…workers.dev/dav`) with `X-Oros-Target`; `davRelayed` turns `X-Oros-Status` into `dav-moved` and `X-Oros-Error` into `dav-too-big` / `dav-relay-target` / `network error: relay <code>`; relay only for public https. (2) Nextcloud chunked upload for plain overwrites over 10 MiB (`davPutChunked`: MKCOL `uploads/<uid>/<id>`, PUT 10 MiB pieces, MOVE `.file`, DELETE on failure; refused or CORS-blocked → single PUT); conditional writes stay one PUT. (3) `connectNextcloud(form, open)` = Login Flow v2 (POST `/index.php/login/v2`, poll every 3 s direct / 7 s via relay up to 20 min, same-origin endpoint check, user id from `current-user-principal`, app password revoked again if connecting fails), `cancelNextcloud()`; shell `sync.connectNc` / `sync.cancelNc` opens the window on the click. `davRevoke` keeps a subfolder install's path. FakeWebDAV: `noCors`, relay, Login Flow, chunked uploads.
- **WebDAV W4 move between providers (2026-10-17).** `moveToWebdav(form)` (Dropbox → WebDAV, also via `connectNextcloud({ move: true })`) and `moveToDropbox()` (sets `oros-sync-move`, signs in to Dropbox; `finishMoveToDropbox()` runs on boot before the engine, result in `moveDone`). `copyCloud(src, dst)` copies the blob and every Vault key as ciphertext (manifest last, blob after it, read-back check; objects checked by revision), refuses a used target (`move-target-used`) or an empty source (`move-empty`), holds the engine lock and refuses Vault adapter calls while it runs (`moving`). On success this device revokes and forgets the old provider; the old cloud is not changed. On-demand Drive entries keep working because their objects are copied. Settings: `Move to WebDAV / Nextcloud` / `Move to Dropbox`; Help sync topic: move steps + Nextcloud, Synology, ownCloud guides. Tests: tests/sync-move.test.js.
- **`errorKey`:** `sync.err.notconnected`, `.nopass`, `.passphrase`, `.busy`, `.suspended`, `.storage` (SY-Q1), `.version`, `.auth`, `.generic`.
- **Accepted limit:** two offline devices with the same app closed converge only when one of them opens it live.

### `notifications.js` [verified 2026-10-06, `VERSION` 1.0.0]

- One IIFE (modern idiom: `const`/`let`/arrows mixed with `var`). Sets `window.orosNotifs`. Loads AFTER `shell.js`; `init()` waits for `orosSync`, then: load slice → register slice → toast stack → bell → `state.ready = true` → `bootSweep()`.
- **Public API:** `VERSION`, `getSetting`, `setSetting`, `getAppToggle`, `setAppToggle`, `getKnownApps`, `fireToast`, `markAsRead`, `emit`, `transient`, `openNotificationPanel`, `updateBadge`, `getState`, `getSlice`, `tick`.
- **`emit(cand)`:**
  - Fields: `ns`, `title` (required), `body`, `key` (dedupe key `ns:key`; without a key: one per `ns:type` per day), `type` (default `reminder`), `deepLink`, `ttlDays` (default 7).
  - Returns the item id, or `null` when: not ready, invalid, notifications disabled, the app toggle is off, or **the dedupe key is already in the inbox**. During quiet hours it still returns an id (inbox + badge, no toast).
  - No `sound` field. Every stored item marks the sync engine dirty.
- **`transient(cand)`:** `title` required; no inbox, no badge, no dedupe, no quiet hours, bypasses toggles; optional `action:{label, fn}` (toast stays ≥ 8 s); returns the id or `null` when not ready. No sound, no native notification.
- **`getAppToggle(ns)` defaults to `true`** for unknown namespaces.
- **`KNOWN_APPS`:** calendar, cycle, mood, todo, habits, time, system, weather, notes, quote, contacts, files, kanban, prompter, storage, spreadsheet, minimalism, television, plants (since Plant Care). Meal Planner wave 3 adds `meals` (pantry best-before reminder).
- **`DL_BRIDGES`:** looked up by own key only (NT-Q1, 2026-10-07). contacts, cycle, mood, calendar (`evId, ymd`), time (pane), todo (listId), habits (offset), weather, quote, minimalism (ymd), television (id), system (`system:open:<appId>` → `__orosOpenApp`), plants (`plants:today` or `plants:<plantId>` → `__orosOpenPlants`), shelf (`shelf:item:<id>` → `__orosOpenAt("shelf", {item})`, 0.65.04). All `typeof`-guarded. `openTarget()` routes `ns:type:id` (third part) and the short `ns:target`.
- **Slice `notifs`, merge-capable since NT-1 (2026-10-06):** `registerSlice('notifs', notifSliceGet, notifSliceSet, null, notifMerge)`. Storage key `oros-notifs` holds `{ ver, settings, appToggles, items, meta }`; `meta` (`lastSweep`) is device-local and is NOT part of the slice.
  - Getter: pure and canonical through `notifBuild()` (sorted keys for settings and toggles; items valid, not gone, one per logical notification, newest first, cap 300).
  - Item identity = `dedupKey` (or the id when there is none). Twins from two devices' engines join: the earlier copy is the base, `readAt` and `firedAt` take the latest stamp ("read" is never undone).
  - Settings and app toggles travel together; `settingsRev` is a monotonic wall-clock stamp (`nextSettingsRev()`), bumped by a real change of a setting OR of a toggle; higher wins the pair, tie → greater JSON.
  - Retention: an item is dropped AT its `expiresAt` (`itemGone`), by the sweep and by the merge alike: 7 days with the default `ttlDays` (decision 2026-10-06; it used to be 14).
  - Setter adopts the merged slice, re-applies the stack position, then toasts fresh (<24 h), unfired items that came from another device.
- **Sweeps:** `bootSweep()` (catch-up toasts; older than 24 h → badge only), `scheduledSweep()` every 60 s through `tick()` from the shell clock and on tab-visible (prune only).
- **Toast stack:**
  - Container `#oros-toast-stack`, z-index 10000, `pointer-events:none` on the container, `auto` on each toast; newest first; 5 visible, the rest mounted and promoted on removal (`applyStackLimits()` on insert and on removal); each toast owns its node, timer and observer (observing the stack).
  - `applyStackPosition()` applies `position` live (`setSetting`, `init`, lazy creation, and after a sync apply). Bottom positions use `column-reverse`. Default `bottom-right` everywhere (decision 2026-10-06).
  - A native Web Notification is added only when permission is already granted, never for catch-up or transient toasts.
- **Inbox panel `#oros-notif-panel`:** z-index 10001, anchored under the bell, width `min(360px, 100vw − 24px)`; closes on the bell, an outside click, or Escape (capture phase on `window`, so the shell's Escape handler does not also close the running app). Only one tray popup at a time (Chris 2026-10-12): opening the orOS menu (button or Ctrl+Alt+Shift+F) calls `orosNotifs.closeNotificationPanel()`, and the bell closes the menu before it opens the panel.
- **Bell:** `#oros-taskbar-bell`, 44×44, inserted before `#btn-lang`; badge = unread count.
- Boot line: `[orOS][notifs] Module v1.0.0 initialized`.
