### `launcher.js` (Favourites: desktop shortcuts + Dock, shell component) [verified 0.49.00]

- Loads after `wallpaper/art.js`, before `shell.js`; touches nothing at parse time. `shell.js` calls `orosLauncher.attach({ apps, open, running, label, icons, lang, desktop })` right after `initPrefs()`, `refresh()` at the end of `renderMenu`, `menuRow(btn, app)` for every app row of the menu and, since 0.50.00, `renderSettings(menu)` ONLY when the launcher has no `setPref` (old bundle); otherwise the Dock settings live in Settings › Appearance through `orosSettings.set("dock:<k>")` → `setPref`. Every call is guarded: a bundle without the file draws what it drew before.
- **Menu:** a star (44×44) at the end of every app row. It opens a panel IN PLACE (no menu rebuild; the open panel survives rebuilds, memory only) with two switches, "On the desktop" and "In the Dock"; when the app is in the Dock and the Dock is off, a line says so with "Turn on". Filled star = the app has a shortcut anywhere.
- **Desktop:** `#ld-desk` inside `#oros-desktop`, an automatic grid in the order added (no free placement: it would differ per screen). Tap opens; right-click, long press (500 ms, 10 px slop, the following click swallowed) or the context-menu key opens a small menu: Open · Move earlier · Move later · Remove from desktop. Arrow keys walk that menu, Escape returns focus to the icon. Long names hyphenate (`lang` on the grid).
- **Dock:** `#ld-dock` (z-index 950: over a running app at 900, under the menu at 999), centred at the bottom, OFF by default. Menu section "Dock" (`#ld-set`, rebuilt in place, focus kept): Show the Dock · Size (small 40 / medium 52 / large 64 px) · Magnify on hover (mouse only, shown only for a fine pointer) · Hide automatically · Show over open apps (off until the user turns it on, on every device; since launcher 1.1.0, before that it followed the pointer). Style (launcher 1.1.0, Settings only): Classic (the original translucent bar, default) · Glass · Frosted · Smoke · Transparent · Solid · 3D shelf · Neon; one `ld-s-<style>` class on `#ld-dock`, skin variables where it can. Hover effect (launcher 1.2.0, mouse only, Settings select replacing the Magnify switch): Magnify (default) · Bounce · Pulse · Frame · Glow · Lift · Wiggle · None; one `ld-h-<effect>` class on `#ld-dock`, effects on `.ld-tile` only; reduced motion turns Bounce / Pulse / Wiggle into the frame. Magnify grows icons from layout positions (`offsetLeft`, never the transformed boxes), slides neighbours apart by the extra width and widens the bar equally on both sides (`--ld-mag`), so icons never overlap and resting centres never move. A dot marks the open app (`aria-current`); tapping the open app never reloads it. Mouse users drag to reorder; touch uses the long-press menu (a finger drag scrolls the Dock: one row, sideways scroll at ≤ 480 px). Auto-hide: a 10 px edge strip (mouse) or a small handle (touch, `#ld-edge`) shows it; leaving or tapping elsewhere hides it; keyboard focus shows it.
- While the Dock is shown and not auto-hidden it sets `--tb-h` on `<html>`: the pet layer (`pet.css`, the old hook) and the desktop grid rise above it; with "over open apps", `html.ld-push` ends `#oros-running` above the Dock. Without "over open apps" a CSS sibling rule hides the Dock while an app runs.
- Styles are injected once (`#ld-css`) and use only skin variables.
- **Menu apps (1.3.0):** `menuHidden(id)`, `menuHiddenIds()`, `setMenuHidden(ids, hidden)`; host option `menuChanged()` (shell passes `renderMenu`) runs after a user change or a pull that changed the list. Schema MENU APPS v1 (Part IV). In `renderAppList` a hidden app is skipped unless a query is typed; category counts count shown apps; with apps hidden a row "n hidden apps · Choose apps" (`.menu-hidden-row`) opens Settings › Menu; with every app hidden the list says so.
- **First-run profiles (1.4.0, `profiles.js` 1.0.0, Chris 2026-10-17):** `presetMenuHidden(ids)` (pure `menuPreset`) hides only apps with no item yet, with `mtime: 1`, so any real choice on any device wins the merge; `menuStored()` says whether the device has menu data. `profiles.js` (loaded by the shell on first use, never at boot) holds BASE + five profile lists (home, work, school, create, games; `pick`, `hiddenOf`, tests/profiles.test.js: every id real, 20+ shown, never all) and the screen "What will you do with orOS? / Τι θα κάνεις με το orOS;". Shell: `tourFirstRun` sets `oros-profile-pending` when the device has no menu data, is not connected to sync and is not a single app; `tourMaybe` shows the screen before the tour. "Everything / Όλα διαθέσιμα" is first and chosen: Continue, × and Escape write nothing. "I already use orOS on another device" skips the tour and opens Settings › Sync. Back from the Dropbox sign-in (the page reloads on the desktop) with no passphrase on the device, the shell opens Settings › Sync again (`syncPassAfterSignIn`, after `vaultUnlocked`; not when a remembered passphrase unlocked or `orosSync.leftForSolo()`), so the passphrase is the next step. Settings › Menu "Choose a profile" (`act("menu.profiles")`, snapshot `menuProfiles`) opens the same screen over the current menu and writes real choices (`setMenuHidden`). With apps hidden the tour's menu step reads `tour.menu.bodyHidden`.

### `seasonal.js` (Seasonal desktop decorations, shell component) [2.23.00]

- Chris 2026-10-15: the desktop decorates itself in season, ON by default, can be turned off and on, and any event can be tried early. Plan and waves: /mnt/project-files/seasonal/seasonal-plan.md (wave 1 = engine + Christmas, New Year, Halloween; wave 2 = Greek feasts incl. Orthodox-Easter-based ones; wave 3 = optional seasons, birthday, Western Easter).
- Loads after `launcher.js`, before `shell.js`. `shell.js` calls `orosSeasonal.attach({ desktop, running, lang, changed })` after `applyLang()` at boot, NOT in single apps (`!SOLO`), and `refresh()` in `openApp` / `returnToDesktop`. Every call is guarded.
- Layer `#ssn-layer` inside `#oros-desktop`, z-index -1 (over the wallpaper and `#wp-live`, under icons), `pointer-events:none`, `aria-hidden`. Still pieces are the file's own constant SVG (tree / Greek boat, string of lights, pomegranate, pumpkins, web + spider); moving ones are one canvas (snow, gold sparkles, fireworks 23:55-00:10 on 31 Dec or the first 25 s of a New Year preview, bats). Colours do not follow the theme (the wallpaper may be dark in the light theme); every piece has a rim or shadow.
- Performance: ≤ 30 fps, rAF stops while an app runs or the tab is hidden; reduced motion, `motion: still`, a low battery (`getBattery`, < 20 % not charging) or a frame time that stays above 55 ms (particles halve, then still) leave only still pieces; `deviceMemory`/`hardwareConcurrency` ≤ 2 = half the particles; count scales with screen area and Amount; a 20 s tick follows the date.
- Preview: Settings › "Try it now" → `act("seasonal.preview", id)` shows it and returns to the desktop; bar `#ssn-bar` (z 960) Keep it · Stop. Kept = device-local until the event's period ends; a preview not kept is memory only. Both win over the main switch.
- 1.1.0 (2.24.00, wave 2): Greek feasts. Movable ones from Orthodox Easter (`ez(y, from, to)`): Carnival −59…−49, Clean Monday −48, Easter −3…+1. Fixed: Epiphany 5-6 Jan, Valentine 13-14 Feb, 25 March (24-25), May Day 30 Apr-1 May, 28 October (27-28). Priorities: Clean Monday / Easter / Valentine 4, New Year 3, Epiphany / Carnival / 25 Mar / 28 Oct 3, Christmas / Halloween / May Day 2 (so 28 Oct beats Halloween, Valentine beats Carnival, Easter beats May Day; no ties on any day, tested 2026-2040). Scenes add bunting / flower wreath top strings, cross, hearts, mask, kite, Greek flag, eggs + candle, and canvas confetti, petals, hearts, butterflies, kites. Settings list sorts events soonest first.
- 1.2.0 (2.25.00, wave 3): `win(y, opt)` takes `optOf(data)` = { western, bday }. Western Easter option (anonymous Gregorian computus) moves only the `easter` event. `birthday` (prio 5, def on but no window until `bday` is set; 29 Feb → 28 Feb in common years). Seasons `spring` 20 Mar-20 Jun, `summer` 21 Jun-22 Sep, `autumn` 23 Sep-30 Nov, `winter` 1 Jan-19 Mar: prio 1, def OFF, listed apart in Settings. New pieces: balloons, tulips, sun (top right), waves strip (`.ssn-bottom`, above the Dock). Plan COMPLETE.
- 1.2.1 (patch, version at stamp): a scene made only of moving things (autumn, winter) draws one frozen frame when still (reduced motion, low battery, Still only, slow device), instead of an empty layer. `snapshot().slow` = the slow-device fallback; Settings hint `z.slow`; changing motion or amount resets it.
- Data: SEASONAL v1 (Part IV).

### `osk.js` (On-screen keyboard, shell component) [1.0.0]

- Chris 2026-10-27 (gap item 6, thread "Πρόσθεσε πληκτρολόγιο οθόνης"): a shell keyboard for touch screens without a keyboard of their own (orOS USB on touch laptops and tablet PCs, touch PCs, kiosks), EN/EL/DE, never on phones.
- Loads right before `phone.js` / `shell.js`. `shell.js` calls `orosOsk.attach({ lang, toast, changed })` at boot (also in SOLO: single apps have text fields), `refresh()` from `applyLang()`, and `watch(el)` from `frameGo` (every app navigation): the new document is wired as soon as it exists, because a heavy app's `load` can come after the first tap. Other frames (mini Assistant…) are wired on their `load`. Every call is guarded.
- Phone (`isPhone`: `userAgentData.mobile`, iPhone/iPod, Android + Mobile, or a coarse pointer with a screen side < 600 px): `attach` stops; no button, no Settings card (`snapshot()` null).
- Modes (device-local `oros-osk`, Part IV): `auto` opens it for a text field focused within 900 ms of a finger or pen tap (`pointerType` touch/pen in the shell or a frame), unless a trusted key was pressed in the last 30 min; a trusted key press closes it; a mouse click or an app's own focus never opens it. `button`: only the top-bar button `#osk-btn` (before `#btn-lang`, 44 px, `aria-pressed`). `off`: nothing. Default (not stored): `auto` on orOS USB (`<html data-oros-kiosk="usb">`, set by the oros-usb system extension) and on Linux with touch (no system keyboard); `button` on other touch screens (Windows, ChromeOS, Android/iPad tablets have their own); `off` without touch.
- Keyboard `#osk` (`role="group"`, `lang` = layout, z 9500, `min(42vh, 300px)`, full width, keys ≤ 1100 px): rows from `keyRows(layout, layer, shift)`; layers `abc` / `sym` / `more`; shift once, twice within 450 ms = Caps Lock; Greek dead keys `΄` (tonos) and shift `¨` (diaeresis) through `combine()`; Backspace and ← → repeat while held; the layout key cycles the enabled layouts and stores `last`. Keys are `tabindex=-1` buttons; `pointerdown`/`mousedown` preventDefault so the field keeps the focus; a click without a pointer (screen reader) also presses.
- Typing: each key is first a synthetic `keydown` (+ `keypress` for characters and Enter) on the field; an app that preventDefaults keeps it. Otherwise `execCommand("insertText" | "delete" | "insertParagraph")` in the field's document (undo + the app's `input` events), fallback `setRangeText` + an `InputEvent`, or a Range for contentEditable. Enter: textarea new line, contentEditable paragraph, input `form.requestSubmit()`. No field (opened from the button): keys go to the app in front as key events only (games). Our events are untrusted, so they never count as a real keyboard.
- Not covering the field: `body.osk-open #oros-running { bottom: var(--osk-h) }`, the field `scrollIntoView({ block: "nearest" })`, then a fixed panel (dialog, mini Assistant) that still covers it is lifted with `translateY` (restored on hide). A field inside a modal `<dialog>` of the shell gets the keyboard moved into that dialog (the rest of the page is inert; an `inert` the screen lock put on the keyboard while it was a body child is removed there, so the PIN can be typed; QA checks it). While open, the field (input/textarea only) gets `inputmode="none"` + `data-osk-im` so no system keyboard opens as well; restored on hide or field change. A field whose app set `inputmode="none"` itself is skipped in `auto`.
- Settings › Language & search › On-screen keyboard (scope device): `set("osk:mode", auto|button|off)`, `set("osk:layout:<en|el|de>", bool)` (one stays on). Search topic `st.osk`. Help: `help/topics/appearance` "On-screen keyboard".
- Tests: `tests/osk.test.js` (layouts, accents, defaults per device, prefs, wiring, strings); `.github/qa/osk.js` (real Chromium with touch: To-Do, Writer, a shell textarea, Greek accents, Enter adds the task, caret, field not covered, real key closes, axe on the open keyboard, nothing at 360 px), in quality.yml shard 1.

### `qsettings.js` (Quick settings, shell component) [QS, 4.53.00]

- Chris 2026-10-30 (thread "Πρόσθεσε Κέντρο ελέγχου στο orOS"): one improvement that makes orOS feel like a full OS; a control centre in **GNOME style, not Windows**, on the web OS, Portable and the Live USB.
- Loads right after `osk.js`, before `phone.js` / `shell.js`; `window.orosQS` (`attach`, `open`, `close`, `toggle`, `isOpen`, `refresh`, `model`). `shell.js` attaches it at boot (also in SOLO) with `{ lang, langNext, langToggle, settings(section), restart, sync: { state, now }, theme: { get, set }, a11y: { get, set }, media }` and calls `refresh()` from `applyLang`. It stores nothing of its own: every switch goes through the owner (`setThemeUser`, `a11ySetUser`, `scToggleLang`, `syncNowFromDot`, `orosNotifs.setDnd`, `orosOsk.show/hide`, `orosLock.lock`).
- Bar: `#qs-btn` is the LAST child of `.bar-right` (after `#bar-date`): network / offline icon, crossed bell while DND, battery icon + % when `batteryShown` (on battery or not full; `navigator.getBattery`, or orOS USB's `<html data-oros-sys-battery="<pct>:<1|0>">`, which wins), power icon. Bar fit level 7 (`bar-nolang`, `BAR_FIT_MAX` 7) hides `#btn-lang`, only while `#qs-btn` exists (the panel has the same language button). Shortcut Ctrl+Alt+Shift+M (SC_DEFS `m`).
- Panel `#qs-panel` (non-modal `role=dialog`, z 1200, 368 px under the bar, radius 22; ≤ 480 px full width with smaller pills): top row battery pill, language, Settings, Lock (only `orosLock.isOn()`), Power (`aria-expanded`, menu `Restart orOS` = `location.reload()` + slot `#qs-power-sys`); slot `#qs-sys` (sliders); grid of GNOME pills (`.qs-pill`, `.qs-pill-main` + optional `.qs-pill-more` arrow; long names wrap to two lines): slot `#qs-sys-pills` (`display: contents`, first), Network (status only; hidden with `<html data-oros-qs-sys="1">`), Sync (tap = sync now, off/locked opens Settings › sync; arrow = Settings › sync), Dark style, Do Not Disturb (arrow: 1 hour / until 08:00 / until off / turn off), Large text (100 ↔ 130), High contrast (explicit on/off), On-screen keyboard (only when `orosOsk.snapshot()` is not null: never on phones); `Playing` rows from `qsMedia()` (Music, Podcasts, Radio, Sound Mixer hosts on the shell window: name, title, Play/Pause, tap = open the app). Closes on Escape (focus back to the button), mousedown/touchstart outside (not inside `#oros-system-panel`), shell window `blur`, and every action that opens something. Repaints every 2 s while open.
- **Do Not Disturb** (notifications.js): device-local `oros-dnd` = `"on"` or the end in ms; `orosNotifs.dnd()` → `{ on, until }`, `orosNotifs.setDnd("on"|ms|false)`; `isQuietHour()` is true while it holds, so notifications still enter the inbox but get no toast or sound (same path as quiet hours).
- **System part (orOS USB):** the page dispatches DOM event `oros-qs` (detail `"open"` / `"close"`, a string so it crosses the extension's isolated world). oros-usb `system/extension/content.js` then fills `#qs-sys` (volume with mute, brightness), `#qs-sys-pills` (Wi-Fi: radio on/off + arrow; Bluetooth: power + arrow; System: its own full panel) and `#qs-power-sys` (Restart the computer, Shut down), with this file's classes; it hides its own System button when `#qs-btn` exists and sets `data-oros-qs-sys="1"`. An older orOS without `#qs-btn` keeps the System button unchanged.
- **Portable:** nothing to change there; the launcher serves this repo's main, so the panel arrives with the Portable's app update.
- Tests: `tests/qsettings.test.js` (DND times and labels, sync labels, battery rule and attribute, notifications.js DND, wiring, EN/EL/DE strings), help `appearance` "Quick settings" EN/EL/DE, Shortcuts topic.

### `widgets.js` (Desktop widgets, shell component) [WG, 4.54.00]

- Chris 2026-10-30 16:24 ("…+ widgets επιφάνειας εργασίας"), plan posted 16:25, go 16:29. Loads after `qsettings.js`, before `shell.js`; `window.orosWidgets` (`attach`, `edit`, `snapshot`, `set(kind, on)`, `wants(kind)`, `refresh`, `model`). `shell.js` attaches it at boot, NOT in SOLO, with `{ desktop, lang, phone, running, open(id), openDay(ymd) (= __orosOpenCalendar("-", ymd): selects the day), appName, weather (wgWeather: tray cache for wxLoc, null when stale/none, {off} offline), media (qsMedia), settings(section), sync: { state, now }, toast, changed }`; `refresh()` from `applyLang`.

- Layout: ≥ 760 px `#wg-col` absolute at the right of `#oros-desktop` (300 px, z 2, like the sticky notes' layer) and `body.wg-col #ld-desk { margin-right: 332px }`; narrower = `.wg-strip`, a sideways row inserted after `#sn-strip` (or first). Cards `.wg-card` (radius 18, blurred panel), head with `⋯` menu (Move up / Move down / Remove / Widgets…), right-click and long press (550 ms, 10 px) open the same menu; with a fine pointer cards are `draggable` (HTML5 DnD reorder). Paints every 1 s only when no app covers the desktop; each card repaints only when its key changed. Text on the accent from `orosQS.model.onAccent`.
- Picker `dialog#wg-dlg` (ticks + up/down) from the desktop menu item `Widgets…` (`__orosDeskItems`) and the card menu; Settings › Appearance › `Desktop widgets` card (scope device, FIND row `widgets`, need `widgets`) with ticks through `set("widgets:<kind>")`. `quickmenu.js` SKIP includes `#wg-col` (a card's right-click is the card's).
- **Storage:** device-local `oros-widgets` `{ v:1, list:[kind…] }`; absent = `clock, calendar, today, weather` when ≥ 760 px and not a phone (coarse pointer and a screen side < 600), else none.
- Tests: `tests/widgets.test.js`, `tests/settings.test.js` (bridge prefix, FIND need).

### `lock.js` (Screen lock, shell component) [LK, 2026-10-27]

- Chris 2026-10-27 (gap audit item 4, thread "Βρες τα κενά για πλήρες web OS"): an optional lock for shared PCs, Portable sticks and the Live USB. Plain lock, NO at-rest encryption, NOT passkey/WebAuthn (rejected 2026-10-17). Off by default, this device only; Settings › `Screen lock` (section `lock`, scope `device`).
- **Load order:** `index.html` loads it right after `translations.js`, BEFORE `solo.js`, `sync.js` and `shell.js`: a locked start never paints the desktop, and its capture `keydown` guard is registered before the shell's shortcut handler. It reads its strings from `OROS_TRANSLATIONS` (+ the `shell` pack) and the language from `orosLang` / `orosI18n.lang()` / `oros-lang`. Single apps (`?solo=`) run the same shell, so they lock too.
- **Storage (device-local, never synced, not in exports; the factory-reset `oros-*` sweep removes it):** `oros-lock` = `{ v:1, kind:"pin"|"pass", salt (16 B, base64), hash (PBKDF2-SHA-256, 32 B, base64), i:600000, idle, hidden }` (`parseCfg`: anything odd, or `i` outside 100 000–5 000 000, reads as no lock); `oros-lock-tries` = `{ n, until }`; sessionStorage `oros-lock-seen` = last activity while unlocked. The secret is NFC-normalized; PIN `^[0-9]{4,12}$`, passphrase 6–256 characters (trimmed length ≥ 6).
- **When it locks:** at start, unless `oros-lock-seen` is younger than min(idle, 10 min) (same tab: update reload, Dropbox return; `stillOpen`); after `idle` minutes (`IDLES` 0/1/2/5/10/15/30/60, default 5, 0 = never) without `pointerdown/pointermove/keydown/wheel/touchstart/scroll` in the shell or any same-origin frame (frames hooked on each 5 s tick, `__orosLockHooked`; checked again on `visibilitychange` → visible); on `visibilitychange` → hidden when `hidden` is on; `Lock now` (Settings, menu row `Lock orOS` under Settings while on, single-app menu) also locks every other orOS tab (BroadcastChannel `oros-lock`). A `storage` event that removes `oros-lock` unlocks the other tabs.
- **Lock screen:** `dialog#oros-lock` opened with `showModal()` (top layer; another `dialog[open]` appearing later re-stacks it on top; `cancel` is prevented and a `close` while locked re-opens it), opaque background, clock + date, one field (`inputmode=numeric` for a PIN). Every body child gets `inert` (new ones too, MutationObserver) and only those are released on unlock; focus inside an app frame is blurred. While locked, keydown with Ctrl/Alt/Meta stops at the capture guard (no shell shortcut, no Ctrl+K) and Tab stays in the dialog. Apps keep running behind it. The broker's `dialog[open]` check holds update reloads while locked.
- **Tries:** 5 free, then 30 s doubling to 15 min (`afterFail`, `waitLeft` caps a far stamp); shared by the PIN, the sync passphrase and the "current" check in Settings.
- **Forgotten:** `Forgot your PIN?` → (sync connected) `orosSync.checkPassphrase(pw)` → true clears `oros-lock` + tries, unlocks, shell hook `recovered` opens Settings › Screen lock with a toast; false = a wrong try; null = "cannot be checked now". Last resort `Reset this device` (two taps) → shell hook `reset` = `lockDeviceReset()` → `scFactoryReset(btn, true)`: `lockLastPush()` first (push when connected + unlocked + dirty, 15 s cap, then `suspendEngine()`), then the usual local legs (OrosFS, tiles, Montage media, map packs, `oros-*` sweep, IDB stage 2) WITHOUT the cloud wipe, the revoke or the backup-folder wipe. Connecting sync again restores everything that reached the cloud.
- **`orosSync.checkPassphrase(pw)`** (sync.js): in-memory passphrase → compare; else the device vault (unseal) → compare; else, connected, `provider.blobGet()` + `withPass(pw, decryptBlob)`: decrypts → true, `OperationError` → false, anything else / empty cloud / not connected → null. Nothing is applied and the session passphrase is untouched.
- **API `window.orosLock`:** `v:1`, `core` (pure: `secretProblem`, `parseCfg`, `parseTries`, `afterFail`, `waitLeft`, `stillOpen`, `sameText`, `makeCfg`, `matches`; Node `require("lock.js")`), `available()`, `isOn()`, `isLocked()`, `snapshot()` → `{ available, on, kind, idle, hidden, idles, busy, locked, wait }`, `enable(kind, secret)`, `change(current, kind, secret)`, `disable(current)` → Promise `{ ok, code? }` (`pin|short|long|wrong|wait|storage|crypto|busy|on`), `option("idle"|"hidden", v)`, `lock()`, `onChange(fn)` → unsubscribe, `setHooks({ reset, recovered })`. The Settings app talks to it directly (like `orosNotifs`), not through `orosSettings`.
- **DL-1:** with `oros-lock` set, `?standalone` no longer keeps the bare app page (the snippet's condition is `!standalone || localStorage.getItem("oros-lock")`), so a typed `/<app>/?standalone` cannot skip the lock.
- **Honest limit (stated in Settings and Help):** it protects the screen, not the disk. Anyone who reads the browser profile or opens developer tools gets past it; nothing on the device is encrypted by it. At-rest encryption would be a later, separate step.
- Tests: `tests/lock.test.js` (core, hash, keys, strings, `checkPassphrase` against the harness), `tests/direct-link.test.js` (lock + `?standalone`), `tests/settings.test.js` (section, search topic).

### Users on one computer or stick (`window.orosUsers`, Settings › Users) [US, U3]

- Chris 2026-11-01 (audit 2026-11 finding 14, plan /mnt/project-files/users/plan.md, "Ναι σε όλα"): separate users with their own data and password on one PC or USB stick, orOS Portable and the Live USB only. Web, PWA and Android get an explanation card only.
- **Design: one user = one browser profile.** The oros-portable launcher (Go, `launcher/users.go`, `usersapi.go`, `session.go`) picks the Chromium `--user-data-dir` per user: the first user keeps `data/` (dir `""`), others `data/users/<id>/`, the guest `data/users/guest` (emptied before and after each session). orOS storage, sync and every app are unchanged; each user's orOS simply sees an empty browser profile of its own (own sync, own Dropbox/WebDAV, own lock).
- **Files:** `data/users.json` (list, PBKDF2-SHA-256 600 000 rounds, owner flag, guest switch, owner's recovery-code hash), `data/users/current.json` (who is signed in), `data/users/signout` (sign-out marker). One user at a time; at most 8 users; roles owner + ordinary; guest off by default; no auto sign-out. 5 free tries, then 30 s doubling to 15 min.
- **Launcher API** `/__oros/users/{state,login,recover,signout,add,remove,password,rename,owner,guest,sizes}`: host check, `Sec-Fetch-Site: same-origin`, same Origin and `X-Oros-Users: 1` on POST; owner actions carry `auth` (the owner's password); the first `add` also sets the owner (`ownerName`, `ownerPassword`) and returns the recovery code once. Sign-in page `/__oros/login` (embedded, strict CSP, EN/EL/DE) in its own profile `data/login`.
- **Shell (`shell.js`, IIFE `users()`):** runs only on localhost/127.0.0.1:47800. `window.orosUsers {v, state, refresh, call, signOut}`; `state.users` feeds Settings. `signOut()` pushes sync first (`lastPush`), posts `signout`, then asks the System extension (orOS USB, DOM event `oros-signout`) or shows `#users-close-dialog` ("close this window"). `usersLeaving` skips the beforeunload guard. Tray `Switch user` arrives as `#oros-signout`.
- **Quick settings:** power menu `Sign out` (`IC.signout`, `qs.signout`) only while `host.users.on()` (2+ users or guest).
- **Settings › Users** (section `users`, after `lock`, `secUsers` in settings.js, strings `u.*` in core.js EN/EL + `i18n/de/settings.js`): first set-up (owner name + password + first user), add, rename, password, owner resets a user's password, remove (the browser profile is deleted; on the USB the user's home moves to the owner as "<name> (removed user)"), owner transfer, guest switch, recovery code card (`.users-code`), folder sizes, sign-out row, honest-limit card. `usersPassOk` (core.js) mirrors the launcher's `validPassword`.
- **orOS USB:** per-user homes `~/oros/homes/<id>` for This computer; the System extension refuses update/install for non-owners (`notOwner`); the sign-in page gets Restart / Shut down on the kiosk.
- **Honest limit (Settings, Help):** passwords keep users apart, they do not encrypt the disk; anyone with the stick and another computer can read the folders. Per-user encryption on the USB is U4 (optional, after U1-U3 are tested on a real PC).
- **Encrypt my files (U4, Chris 2026-11-01 "Ξεκίνα. Προαιρετική επιλογή, όχι default"):** orOS USB only (`state.vault` true), any signed-in user but the first (`me.first`) and the guest. Settings card `u.vault` → modes `vaultOn` / `vaultOff` (password field `vpw`) → `orosUsers.call("vault", {on, password})` (`vault` added to the shell's `NAMES`); turning on answers a recovery code shown in the code card with `u.vault.codeHint` (`us.codeKind = "vault"`). States from the launcher: `pending` (at the next sign-in), `on`, `off-pending`, `failed` (+ `vaultError` space|copy). The owner gets no Reset button for an encrypted user (`u.vault.noReset`; the launcher refuses with `vault`), and the remove form warns that the files go (`u.vault.removeWarn`). Launcher side: `launcher/vault.go` (fscrypt v2 folder `<persistence>/oros-vaults/<id>` behind links `data/users/<id>` and `homes/<id>`, opened at sign-in, locked at sign-out and before every sign-in window, key sealed AES-256-GCM by the password and the user's own recovery code, copy + SHA-256 compare before the swap); oros-usb: initramfs `oros-fscrypt` sets the ext4 `encrypt` feature before mount, `mkfs.ext4 -O encrypt`, `oros-system vault-base` (sudo) and the QEMU self-test `selftest-vault`. Honest limit: data written before encryption may stay in unused flash blocks.
- Tests: oros-portable `launcher/users_test.go`, `vault_test.go`, `vault_linux_test.go` + `fscrypt_linux_test.go` (real fscrypt on a loop ext4 in CI), oros-usb `system/users_test.go`, `system/vault_test.go`, boot test `.oros-selftest-vault`; here `tests/settings.test.js` (section list).

### Sticky Notes (`stickies/`, shell side `stickies/host.js`) [1.02.00]
- `stickies/core.js` (UMD `StickiesCore`, pure) + `stickies/host.js` load in `index.html` right after `today/host.js` (so after `notifications.js`). Inert until `apps.json` lists `stickies` (`orosStickiesEnv.registered()`).
- The host is the ONLY writer of `oros-stickies-data` (slice `stickies`, registered by the host with no storage key, merge `StickiesCore.merge`). The app (`stickies/stickies.js`) only reads and asks through `window.parent.orosStickies` (`data`, `prefs`, `setPref`, `newNote`, `create`, `edit`, `show`, `remove` (Undo toast), `restore`, `fade`, `tidy`, `testSound`, `exportText`, `onChange`).
- Desktop: `#sn-layer` (fixed, inside `#oros-desktop`, z-index 2 in the desktop's stacking context, so a running app hides it and the pet stays in front) with free notes on screens ≥ 600 px; `#sn-strip` (first child of `#oros-desktop`, a row of cards above the launcher grid) under 600 px; `#sn-add` round "+" bottom-left above `--tb-h`. Right-click / long press on an empty desktop spot: New sticky note · Tidy up · Open the app.
- Editor: one centred `<dialog id="sn-sheet">` in the shell document (also over the app): text, colour, Ring (quick picks + datetime-local), Vanish (quick picks + datetime-local + "also when the ring is Done"), Delete, Done.
- In-place typing (wide screens): an empty NEW note goes away when its edit ends empty (click outside, Escape), or when the editor dialog is closed empty. **SN-F1 (fix, 2026-10-27):** a press on the note's own Fold / More button blurs the text box before the click arrives; the blur used to end the edit there, which redrew the note (the click was lost) and removed a new note still empty, so Fold / More made it vanish. Now the press holds the edit (`holdEdit`, `editing.hold`), the button's click ends it with `stopEdit(quiet, keep)` (the note stays: Fold keeps it folded, More hands it to the editor, which keeps its own empty-note rule), and a press that never becomes a click ends the edit 700 ms after the pointer is let go. `openEditor` reads the note after `stopEdit` saved the typed text (before, text typed less than 500 ms before More was overwritten with the old text). Positions stay device-local and the synced slice is written only through `commit`, as before.
- Engine: `orosStickies.tick()` every second from the shell clock (`stickiesTick`, inside the engines-may-run block). Rings: wiggle + chime (Web Audio, three presets, notification volume, off in quiet hours / with notifications or the Sticky Notes toggle off) + `orosNotifs.emit` (`ns:"stickies"`, key `ring-<id>-<at>`, deep link `stickies:<id>` → `__orosOpenStickies`). A ring found more than 2 min late is announced without sound. Fades at `vanish.at` and empties the Faded bin after 7 days with stamps computed from the data (identical bytes on every device).
- Shortcut Ctrl+Alt+Shift+N (`scNewSticky`).
- Phase 2 [1.12.00]: `ring` may be `{ at, rep, t }` (rep "daily" | "weekdays" | "weekly", t = the planned moment of this round; Snooze moves `at` only; Done moves both to `nextRound(rep, t, max(now, t))`, local clock time kept, and never fades the note). A ring without a repeat keeps the v1 bytes `{ at }`. Editor: Repeat select under the ring time; Send to To-Do (BR-TD-ADD: open `[ ]` lines → tasks, else one task = first line + rest as note) and Copy to Notes (`__orosOpenAt("notes", { add: { title, text } })`), shown only for installed apps (`orosAssistInstalled`), prefill only. Ring sound pref may be `"rt:<melody id>"`: the host reads `oros-ringtones-data` (never writes it), loads `ringtones/core.js` on first need, plays `renderSamples` (≤ 15 s, notification volume); a deleted melody plays the bell. Universal search provider `stickies/search.js` (notes on the desktop; target `{ note }`, opens through `__orosOpenStickies`); Today provider `stickies/today.js` (one task row per open ring, late ones Overdue, repeating rings up to the horizon, max 8 rounds).

### Meal Planner pantry engine + bridge (`meals/`, wave 3)
- `mealsCheckTick` (shell, 60 s throttle): reads `oros-meals-data` with the app closed and asks `OrosMealsPantry.expiryNotice(raw, today)` (`meals/pantry.js`, loaded by index.html, the same file the app runs; it needs no core.js: it validates ids, takes the newest copy per id and honours tombs itself) which pantry items reach their best-before day today or tomorrow. Off unless `oros-meals-prefs.nt` is an hour 0–23 (device-local, default -1); from that hour on, one notice per day per set of items: key `bb-<today>-<djb2 of id:d list>`, body "Best before today: … · Best before tomorrow: …" (3 names + "and N more"), deepLink `meals:pantry` → `__orosOpenAt("meals", { pantry: true })` (Pantry tab). `meals` joined `KNOWN_APPS`. Nothing due = silent (SH-B7).
- `budgetCheckTick` (shell, 60 s throttle): reads `oros-budget-data` with the app closed and asks `OrosBudgetPlan.subsDue(raw, today)` (`budget/plan.js`, loaded by index.html, the same file the app runs) which recurring expenses with a reminder lead `nd` charge within it. From the device-local hour `oros-budget-prefs.nh` (default 9, -1 = off on this device); one notice per charge, key `sub-<recId>-<yyyymmdd>`, body "Netflix: 12,99 € tomorrow", deepLink `budget:sub:<recId>` → `__orosOpenAt("budget", { sub })` (Recurring › Subscriptions with the entry open). `budget` already in `KNOWN_APPS`. No reminders set = silent (SH-B7).

### Stock engine + bridges (`stock/`, 1.04.00)
- `stockCheckTick` (shell, 60 s throttle): reads `oros-stock-data` with the app closed, `OrosStockCore.lowList` + `toNotify`: a product is announced once when it ENTERS the low list and again only after it left it (device-local `oros-stock-notified`). At most one grouped notification per tick (3 names + "and N more"), key `low-<today>-<djb2>`, deepLink `stock:<itemId>` (one product) or `stock:reorder`. Switch `oros-stock-prefs.notify`; while off the map still follows the list (no replay when switched on). No products = silent (SH-B7).
- Today provider `stock/today.js` (apps.json `"today": "today.js"`, uses the shell's OrosStockCore): an info line "To reorder: N" while products are low (`{view: "reorder"}`), and open purchase orders whose expected day is past or within the horizon as tasks on that day (`{po}`; late ones land in Overdue). No `open()`: Today falls back to `__orosOpenAt("stock", target)`.
- Stock's receiver also takes `{po: id}` (order sheet) and `{view: "reports"}`.
- Outgoing bridges (all prefills, nothing written elsewhere until saved there): To-Do BR-TD-ADD (a Reorder supplier group or an order: `newList` "Order · <supplier>", items "8 pcs × Name (supplier code)"); Mail compose (to = supplier e-mail, shown only when Mail has an account on the device); Budget BR-B1 from a receipt (`k:"o"`, `c:"o-other"`) or a sale (`k:"i"`, `c:"i-other"`), amount = the movement total, `src:"stock"`; Quote BR-Q1 from a product sheet or "Quote from products" (any ISO currency since wave 46; before, EUR/USD only); Spreadsheet BR-S1 from Reports (one row per product, sums on value and sales, at most 499 rows).
- **Counter** (`New` › `Counter (quick sale)`): scan / search adds one unit per scan, − / + per line, total at sale prices; `Complete sale` writes ONE `out` movement (ref "Counter" / «Ταμείο», `p` = the product's sale price when set) after the usual below-zero check (confirm, or refused when `settings.neg = 0`); Undo in the toast voids it. The open sale is page memory only (kept while the counter is closed and reopened; lost on reload); nothing is written before Complete.
- **Barcode labels** (`New` › `Barcode labels`, product sheet): line picker (copies + price on the label), A4 sheet 3 × 8 of 70 × 37 mm, at most 240 labels; printed from a hidden `srcdoc` frame (`#st-print`, all text escaped). Products without barcode or SKU are named and skipped.
- Toasts: a closing dialog hands the toast to the dialog still open under it (fix: Undo after a confirm over the counter was unreachable).
- **Camera scanning:** a 📷 button next to the product search, the movement editor's finder and the counter, shown only where `BarcodeDetector` and `getUserMedia` exist (Chrome on Android); elsewhere hidden, a scanner that types still works. A read code goes into the field followed by a synthetic Enter, so each field keeps its own rules. Search: one code, then the camera closes. Editor / counter: stays open; the same code counts again only after it left the picture (≥ 1.2 s). Tracks stop when the dialog closes. Nothing leaves the device.
- **Warehouses** (Settings › Warehouses): the main one can only be renamed; another one is deleted while unused, else archived (confirm if it still holds stock). With at least one active extra warehouse: a Warehouse select in the movement editor (From / To for a transfer, same pair refused), the counter, receipts from purchase orders and BR-ST-OUT; New › Transfer; a Products filter by warehouse (quantity, "out of stock" and qty sort per warehouse; minimums and Reorder stay business-wide); "By warehouse" in the product sheet; stock count and the below-zero check use the chosen warehouse's quantity; Reports adds Value per warehouse; Movements CSV gets Warehouse + To warehouse columns.
- **Lots:** receipt / customer-return lines get Lot + Expires behind "+ Lot / expiry" (open by themselves once the product has lots; an expiry alone becomes the lot name; known lots suggested). Sale / return to supplier / loss lines of a product with lots left get a Lot select, default "First to expire". The counter always takes the first to expire. Product sheet: Lots (expired red, ≤ 30 days amber, "Without a lot"). Products chip "Expiring" (≤ 30 days, only when such lots exist). Reports: "Expiring within 30 days". Movements CSV gets Lot + Expiry columns when any lot exists.
- **Today (stock/today.js 1.1):** lots expiring within 7 days as tasks on their expiry day (expired → Overdue), target {item}. 1.2 (3.81.00): consignment shops due for a settlement as tasks on their due day, target {view: "cons"}.
- **Close a period** (Settings): default 31 Dec of last year (or yesterday after a later close); must be before today and after the current close; says how many movements go; confirm; archive file, then close. Movement dates inside the closed period are refused (editor min date; BR-ST-OUT falls back to today). Movements list shows the Opening balance row (sheet with warehouse / lot per line, no Void). **Reopen** (same dialog, on a device that has the archive file): tombstone on the close, then the archive merges back. The dialog shows the size of the Stock data on this device.
- Two-device E2E: an offline sale dated inside the period, synced after the close, stays and counts on top of the opening; the other device's old copies drop; reopen restores all on both.
- `keepCheckTickThrottled` (shell, 60 s, Contacts wave 26): reads `oros-contacts-data` with the app closed (`OrosContactsKeep` from `contacts/keep.js`, loaded by `index.html`) and the device-local switch `oros-contacts-keep` (default off, hour 10); one notice per day (ns contacts, key `keep-<ymd>`) once the hour has come and someone is overdue; deep link `contacts:<id>` or `contacts:@reachout`.
- `crmCheckTickThrottled` (shell, 60 s, CRM v1.1.0 at 1.14.00): reads `oros-crm-data` with the app closed (`OrosCrmCore` from `crm/core.js`, loaded by `index.html`) and device-local `oros-crm-notified`; notice ns crm, key `fup-<id>|<day><time>` per open follow-up once due (earlier days; today untimed; today at or after its time), at most 10 per tick, nothing marked before the inbox is ready; deep link `crm:<followUpId>`; not absorbed by Today (per item, like Health doses). The app's own reminder loop is gone.
- DL_BRIDGES `stock:` → `__orosOpenAt("stock", {view: "reorder"} | {item: id})`. Stock's single receiver (`window.__orosOpenAt` + boot `__orosTakeTarget("stock")`) takes `{item}`, `{sup}` (universal search) and `{view: "reorder"}`; ignored while a dialog is open. 3.69.00: `{newItem: {name, sku?, bc?, price?, note?}}` (Publishing P2) opens a new product prefilled, saved only on Save; a product with the same SKU or barcode opens instead.
- Universal search: `stock/search.js` (products: name; SKU, barcode, category, location, supplier, supplier code, note; suppliers: name; person, phone, e-mail, VAT no.). Archived products and tombstoned rows skipped (an item with movements never counts as deleted).
- Outgoing: Label Maker `__orosOpenAt("labels", {text: name · SKU})` from the product sheet. Contacts read-only (`oros-contacts-data`) for "From Contacts" in a new supplier (copy, nothing written back).

### Connected services (`links/`, integrations wave 1)
- **What.** One owner in the shell for every account orOS keeps with another platform (plan /mnt/project-files/integrations/integrations-plan.md). Wave 1 = WooCommerce (Stock). No app asks for, stores or sends keys itself; apps call `parent.orosLinks`.
- **Files.** `links/core.js` (`OrosLinksCore`, pure, Node-testable: PLATFORMS, normSite/normAcct, merge, checkKeys, checkReq allowlist, extId), `links/host.js` (`window.orosLinks`, shell; index.html loads core.js + host.js after stickies/host.js), `links/woo.js` (`OrosLinksWoo`, WooCommerce mapping: productPlan, compare, stockReq, normOrder, outRequest, invoicePrefill, budgetPrefill, crmLog), `stock/shop.js` (Stock's shop panel), `relay/ext.js` (relay op `ext`), since 1.58.00 `links/mydata.js` + `invoices/mydata-ui.js` (myDATA). Tests `tests/links.test.js` (one case list run against both checkReq and the relay's checkExtReq), `tests/mydata.test.js`.
- **Slice `links`** (key `oros-links-data`, registered by the shell): `{accts: [{id, m, p, name, site, ks, s?, sm?, d?}]}`. LWW per id by `m` (tie: tombstone, then larger canonical JSON); a tombstone keeps only `{id, m, p, d:1}`. No keys in clear, ever.
- **Keys.** IndexedDB `oros-links` (stores `keys`: non-extractable AES-GCM key; `creds`: id → `{iv, data, m}`), device only, never synced or exported, in the factory-reset list. Opt-in per account (`ks: 1`, "Use on all my devices"): the keys also travel as `s` sealed with `orosSync.vaultCrypto` (sync passphrase), only while sync is connected and unlocked; resealed only when the local `m` is newer than `sm` or no sealed copy exists (no upload loop). A device without keys takes them from `s`.
- **API (`window.orosLinks`).** `list(p?)`, `get(id)`, `add({p, name, site, keys})`, `edit(id, fields)`, `setKeys(id, keys)`, `hasKeys(id)`, `setKeySync(id, on)`, `canKeySync()`, `remove(id)`, `call(id, reqs ≤ 10)` → `{ok, res:[{status, data|err}]}` or `{ok:false, err}`, `test(id)`, `statusCode`, `mode(id)`, `onChange(fn)`, `platforms`. Error codes only (offline, auth, notfound, keys, relay, network, denied, server, busy, gone, bad), never text from the shop.
- **Call path.** Every request must pass `checkReq` (exact allowlist per platform). WooCommerce: direct with Basic auth; on 401 retry with the keys in the query (hosts that drop the Authorization header); when the browser can't reach the shop, the relay `ext` op. The way that worked is remembered per account in device-local `oros-links-prefs`.
- **Settings › Connected services** (section `services`, before System): add / test / edit / replace keys / key-sync switch / two-tap Disconnect / Open Stock.
- **Service picker** (2026-10-16, Chris: the native list was "άχαρο"): "Connect a service" first shows tiles grouped by purpose (shop & invoicing, email marketing, CRM, tasks/notes/bookmarks, other), each with a coloured monogram (`SVC_MARK` + `.svc-mark.m-<id>` in settings.css; no third-party logos or logo CDNs), the apps it works with, a "Connected · n" badge and a search box that filters in place. Picking a tile opens the same form as before, headed by the chosen service with a Change button. A new platform needs an entry in `SVC_GROUPS`, `SVC_MARK` and a colour (tested), or it lands under "Other services" with a plain initial.
- **Stock shop panel** (`__orosOpenAt("stock", {view: "shop"})`, add sheet and Settings › Data): Products (import as Stock items with ids `extId("woo", acct, product)` and one count move, compare, send our stock to the shop or take theirs) and Orders (last 30 days, ≤ 50: record sale through BR-ST-OUT with `src "woo:<acct>-<order>"`, invoice via BR-CRM-INV, CRM log via BR-CRM-MAIL, Budget via BR-B1, mark completed). Every prefill opens unsaved, as the bridges require.
- **timologisi.online (`p: "tol"`, wave 2, 1.58.00).** Greek e-invoicing provider (Novus provider API, `/api/v1/Provider`). Account rows add `env` (`test` → provider-dev.timologisi.online, `live` → provider.timologisi.online; fixed hosts, no site) and `vat` (issuer ΑΦΜ, 9 digits); `normAcct` writes `env`/`vat` only for platforms that have them, so WooCommerce rows keep their bytes. Key `{key}` (header `API-KEY`). Allowlist: GET `/GetCreditsBalance` (the probe and `test()`), GET `/RequestTransmittedDocs` (issuerVatNumber, issuedFrom/To, uid, invoiceMark, series, aa, invoiceType, branch), POST `/SendInvoices` with exactly one invoice (`okInvoice`: known top-level keys, type in TOL_TYPES 1.1–1.3, 2.1–2.3, 5.1, 5.2, 11.1, 11.2, 11.4, issuer ΑΦΜ 9 digits, ≤ 64 KB). An older 1.57 device drops `tol` rows in its own copy; the union restores them on newer devices.
- **Writes that must happen once (`once: true`).** A platform marked `once` never retries or falls back on a write: with no known route the shell first runs the probe GET to learn it; a failed or unanswered write returns `unknown` (not `network`), and the caller must look the document up before sending again. `test()` uses each platform's `probe`.
- **Email platforms (wave 3, 1.59.00).** `mlite` (MailerLite, connect.mailerlite.com/api, Bearer), `mchimp` (Mailchimp, `<dc>.api.mailchimp.com/3.0`, dc = the key's suffix, Basic `oros:key`, `relayOnly`: never asked from the browser), `brevo` (api.brevo.com/v3, header `api-key`). Platform fields `host` / `hostOf(keys)`; `L.apiUrl(p, acct, path, keys)`, `L.authHeader(p, keys)`. One key `{key}` each. Allowlist: groups / audiences / lists, their members (MailerLite `filter[status]` + cursor; Mailchimp `count/offset/status` + a fixed `fields`; Brevo `limit/offset`), and writes: MailerLite `POST /batch` (≤ 50 `POST api/subscribers` upserts; `status` only "unsubscribed", never `resubscribe`), Mailchimp `POST /lists/<id>` (≤ 250 members; "subscribed" only with `update_existing:false`), Brevo `POST /contacts/import` (≤ 250 rows, one list) and `POST /contacts/lists/<id>/contacts/remove` (≤ 150). `links/mail.js` (`OrosLinksMail`, pure): `groupsReq/readGroups`, `membersReq/readMembers` (st on/off/bounce/spam), `plan(local, remote, {pull, push, supp})` → `{offHere, offThere, add, send}`, `pushReqs`, `unsubReqs`, `readWrite`. `newsletter/platforms.js` (`OrosNewsletterPlatforms`): Subscribers › Email platforms (link / Sync / Unlink). Sync order: read everything there → show the plan → Apply: this list first (saved), then unsubscribes there, then additions there. Added people: `src "platform"`, basis consent, tag = the platform's name.
- **CRMs (wave 4, 1.60.00).** `hubspot` (api.hubapi.com, root "", Bearer private-app token `pat-…`, `relayOnly`) and `pdrive` (Pipedrive, api.pipedrive.com/api/v2, header `x-api-token`, 40-hex token), apps ["crm"]. Read-only allowlist: HubSpot `GET /crm/v3/pipelines/deals` and `/crm/v3/objects/{companies,contacts,deals}` (limit ≤ 100, `after`, one fixed `properties` list each, fixed `associations`); Pipedrive v2 `GET /stages`, `/organizations`, `/persons`, `/deals` (`status`), `/activities` (`done`), limit ≤ 500, `cursor` (`%2B`/`%2F`/`%3D` allowed there only; checkReq refuses any other `%`). `links/crm.js` (`OrosLinksCrm`, pure): `KINDS[p]`, `req(p, kind, at)`, `read(p, kind, data)` → `{items, next}`, `plan(C, crm, got, {p, acct, src, now, upd, revive})` → `{cust|deals|fups: {add, upd}, same, here, gone, noCust, otherCur, over}`, `count`. Ids `extId(p, acct, "org"|"person"|"deal"|"act", xid)`. Companies → customers (contacts as `people` lines; a contact without a company → a person customer); a customer already here by name or e-mail is used, never changed (`here`); deals: won/lost kept, open → the built-in stage by probability (≤15 new, ≤35 contact, ≤60 proposal, else nego), a value only in CRM's currency (else 0 + a note on add); Pipedrive open activities → follow-ups (a local `done` is kept). Updates overlay only the platform's fields (cust: name, kind, phone, email, web, addr, country, job, people; deal: cust, title, val, stage, prob, close, cd, why; fup: cust, d, t, text, deal). A tombstoned id is not brought back unless `revive`. `crm/platforms.js` (`OrosCrmPlatforms`): CRM › Settings › Import from HubSpot or Pipedrive (Read → plan → Import; one commit, Undo tombs the added and restores the changed). No new CRM fields.
- **Payments (wave 4B, 1.61.00).** `stripe` (api.stripe.com/v1, Bearer, `relayOnly`, apps ["budget"]): a restricted key only (`rk_(live|test)_…`; `sk_` refused by the key pattern, app and relay). Read-only allowlist: GET `/balance` (probe), GET `/balance_transactions` (limit ≤ 100, `starting_after` txn_…, `created[gte]`/`created[lt]` unix). `links/pay.js` (`OrosLinksPay`, pure): `req(fromSec, after)`, `read(data)` → `{items, next}` (next = last id while `has_more`), `plan({tx, tombs, cur}, items, {acct, src, feeNote, catIn, catOut, ac})` → `{add, same, gone, otherCur, skip}`. charge/payment → income (gross, id `extId("stripe", acct, "txn", txn)`) + its fee → expense (`"fee"`); refund/payment_refund/stripe_fee → expense; adjustment/dispute by sign; payout/transfer/topup/reserve etc. skipped; other currencies than Budget's skipped; zero-decimal currencies (JPY …) × 100; a `tx:<id>` tomb is not brought back. `budget/payments.js` (`OrosBudgetPay`): More › Import from Stripe (account, from date, income/expense category, Budget account) → Read → Import (one commit; Undo tombstones the added). No new Budget fields.

Read-only allowlist: GET `/statics`, `/clients` (`per_page` ≤ 100, `page`, `status=active`), `/payments` (`per_page`, `page`). CRM: `links/crm.js` KINDS.ininja ["orgs"]; a client → a customer with its contacts as `people`, `afm` from `vat_number` (EL prefix and spaces dropped), matched first by ΑΦΜ, then name/e-mail; `afm` is in the overlay fields for ininja only. Budget: `links/pay.js` `inReq(kind, page)`, `inCurrencies(statics)` (currency id → code), `inRead(data, curMap, fromYmd)` → payments with status completed / partly or fully refunded / unapplied, net of `refunded`, as income (`cents: true`, date as given; the API has no date filter, so it is applied client-side); `plan` takes `ctx.p` for the ids (`extId("ininja", acct, "txn", id)`). No new CRM or Budget fields.
- **Odoo (wave 4D).** `odoo` (`site: true`, `db: true`: the account row also carries `db`, "" or `[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]{0,62}`, sent as `X-Odoo-Database` via `L.extraHeaders(p, acct)`; address normalised like WooCommerce's, with a trailing `/odoo…`, `/web…` or `/json/2` dropped; root `/json/2` (Odoo 19's JSON-2 API); `Authorization: Bearer <API key>`), apps ["crm"]. Direct first (Odoo sends no CORS, so in practice one failed try, then the relay). `probe` may now be a whole request (`L.probeReq(p)`): Odoo's is a POST. Read-only allowlist: POST `/res.company/search_read`, `/res.partner/search_read`, `/crm.lead/search_read` only, each body exactly the fixed JSON in `L.ODOO` (domain, fields, `order: "id"`) plus `limit` 1–200 and `offset`; checkReq compares those as JSON (`"=<name>"` body kinds). `links/crm.js`: KINDS.odoo ["own", "orgs", "deals"], pages by offset (`read(p, kind, data, at)`), OPTIONAL.odoo.deals (no CRM app → no deals, not an error). Plan: the companies' own partners and their children stay out; a company → a customer with its child contacts (type contact) as `people`; a top-level non-company → a person customer; `afm` from `vat` (EL/GR prefix dropped), matched first; an opportunity → a deal (inactive = lost with its reason, probability 100 = won, else stage by probability), a contact's deal belongs to its company. No new CRM fields.
- **Todoist (wave 6A).** `todoist` (fixed host `api.todoist.com`, root `/api/v1`, `Authorization: Bearer <API token>` = 40 hex digits), apps ["todo"], probe `/projects?limit=1`. Direct first, the relay's ext op as fallback. Read-only allowlist: GET `/projects` and `/tasks` with `limit` (1–200) and `cursor` (base64; `%2B %2F %3D` only, like Pipedrive's). `links/todo.js` (`OrosLinksTodo`, pure, Node-tested in `tests/linkstodoist.test.js`): KINDS.todoist ["projects", "tasks"], pages by `next_cursor` (a cursor that doesn't move or isn't base64 ends the reading), MAX 1000 projects / 5000 tasks; `plan(st, got, ctx)` on To-Do's state: a project with open tasks → a list (`L.extId(p, acct, "list", id)`, Inbox first), a task → a task (`extId … "task"`): text ≤ 500, description → notes, `due.date` → due (date only), labels by name (any existing label of that name, else `extId … "label", lowercased name`), priority 4/3/2/1 → the task's own `prio` 1/2/3/(none) (since the To-Do TD-14 wave; before it, an extra-info field id `tdprio` value P1/P2/P3, which tasks imported then keep untouched); subtasks flat right after their parent; repeating tasks only their next date. Again: update (opt-in, default on) only text, notes, due, `prio`, labels only added; never `done`, other labels, info (the old `tdprio` field included) or recurrence. Deleted here (tombstone) → skipped unless `revive`; a new task whose text is open in its list → skipped (`here`). To-Do: `List settings › Import from Todoist…` (`todo/platforms.js`, `OrosTodoPlatforms`), applied by `importApply` in todo.js section 14 (ids from the plan, field stamps newest) with its own Undo (`undoFn`: added items, lists and labels tombstoned, updated fields put back).
- **Trello and GitHub (wave 6B).** `trello` (fixed host `api.trello.com`, root `/1`, keys `key` = 32 hex + `token` = 64–100 alphanumerics, header `Authorization: OAuth oauth_consumer_key="…", oauth_token="…"`, never in the query) and `github` (fixed host `api.github.com`, `Bearer` personal access token `github_pat_…` or `ghp_…`; the relay adds `X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2022-11-28`), apps ["kanban"]. A platform with two secrets: `checkKeys` checks every key field, Settings shows a second `Token` field for Trello, and `links/host.js` viaRelay copies every key field of a fixed-host platform. Direct first, the relay's ext op as fallback. Read-only allowlist: Trello GET `/members/me/boards?filter=open&fields=name` and `/boards/<24 hex>` with the one fixed field list; GitHub GET `/user/repos` (`per_page` ≤ 100, `page`, `sort=updated`) and `/repos/<owner>/<repo>/issues` (`state=open|all`, `per_page`, `page`). `links/kanban.js` (`OrosLinksKanban`, pure, Node-tested in `tests/linkskanban.test.js`): `listReq/readList` (boards / non-archived repos, ≤ 10 pages), `boardReq`, `readIssues` (pull requests out, ≤ 10 pages of 100), `toExport(p, id, got, names)` → a Trello-export-shaped board, so Kanban's `Import from other apps` dialog takes it through `trelloAdapter` and the idempotent `importInto` like a file (ids `imp-t-<id>`; again: only missing columns, cards, labels; tombstones respected). GitHub: board `gh-<slug>`, columns `-open` / `-closed` (named by the app), issue → card `gh<id>` "#n title", body → notes, milestone `due_on` → due, labels `gh<id>`, body `- [ ]` / `- [x]` lines → subtasks. Kanban: `accountSection` in the import dialog (account, `Show boards`/`Show repositories`, board/repo, `Read`).
- **Raindrop.io (wave 6C).** `raindrop` (fixed host `api.raindrop.io`, root `/rest/v1`, `Authorization: Bearer <test token>` = 30–80 of `A-Za-z0-9-`), apps ["bookmarks"], probe `/collections`. Direct first, the relay's ext op as fallback. Read-only allowlist: GET `/collections`, `/collections/childrens` (no query) and `/raindrops/0` with `perpage` (1–50) and `page`. `links/bookmarks.js` (`OrosLinksBookmarks`, pure, Node-tested in `tests/linksraindrop.test.js`): KINDS.raindrop ["collections", "children", "raindrops"], bookmarks page while a page is full (MAX 5000); system collections (≤ 0) are not folders, the trash (−99) is skipped, links only http(s). `plan(st, got, ctx)` on Bookmarks' state: a collection → a folder by name (any existing folder of that name, case-insensitive, else `L.extId(p, acct, "folder", id)`; nested collections flat by their own name; Unsorted / unknown → `unsorted`), a bookmark → `extId … "bookmark"`: link, title (else the link), note (else excerpt, ≤ 1024), tags (≤ 12 × 32), `important` → `fav`; a link already here by Bookmarks' `dupeKey` → skipped (`here`). Again: update (opt-in, default on) only title and note, tags only added; never folder, fav, visits, pos. Deleted here (tombstone, item or its folder) → skipped unless `revive`. Bookmarks: the cloud button `Import from Raindrop.io…` (`bookmarks/platforms.js`, `OrosBookmarksPlatforms`, shown only inside the shell), applied by `platformApply` in bookmarks.js section 9 with its own Undo (`platformUndo`: added bookmarks tombstoned, added folders tombstoned while empty, updated fields put back).
- **Notion (wave 6D).** `notion` (fixed host `api.notion.com`, root `/v1`, `Authorization: Bearer <secret>` = `ntn_` or `secret_` + 30–80 alphanumerics; the relay adds `Notion-Version: 2022-06-28`), apps ["notes"], probe = the search with `page_size: 1`, `relayOnly` (Notion answers no browser). Read-only allowlist: `POST /search` whose body is exactly the fixed filter `{"property":"object","value":"page"}` (required, whole rule `ntq`) plus `page_size` (1–100, kind `nlim`) and `start_cursor` (UUID, kind `ncur`); `GET /blocks/<uuid>/children` with `page_size` ≤ 100 and a UUID `start_cursor`. `links/notes.js` (`OrosLinksNotes`, pure, Node-tested in `tests/linksnotion.test.js`): `searchReq/readSearch` (pages only; database rows, trash and odd ids out; title from the property of type title), `blocksReq/readBlocks`, `toText` (headings `#`, lists `-` / `n.`, to-dos `- [ ]`/`- [x]`, toggles `▸`, quotes and callouts `>`, code fences, dividers, table rows `a | b`, bookmarks as their link, media as `[Image] caption url` with Notion-hosted file links left out because they expire; children indented under list items, flat under containers), `plan(st, got, ctx)` on Notes' state: one notebook per account (`L.extId(p, acct, "notebook", "workspace")`, named Notion, created only with a first new page), a page → `extId … "page"` under its parent page when that came too (parents placed first), untitled → the app's word; again: same unless `upd` (opt-in, OFF by default: it replaces title and text, Undo puts them back), deleted page or notebook (tomb) → skipped unless `revive`. `notes/platforms.js` (`OrosNotesPlatforms`): search by cursor (MAX 300 pages), then a queue of block reads, 5 per relay call with 1.7 s between calls (relay 60 calls/min, Notion ~3 req/s), children of nesting blocks to depth 2, 5 pages of blocks per parent, "busy" retried twice; Notes: cloud button in the tree footer (shell only), `platformApply` / `platformUndo` in notes.js (Undo through the shell notice's action).
- **Notion databases (wave 6E).** Same `notion` platform, now apps ["notes", "spreadsheet"]. The search's filter may be either fixed value (okVal kind `"=nt_flt|nt_dbf"`: `"=a|b"` = exactly one of the listed fixed JSON values, in both copies), plus `POST /databases/<uuid>/query` whose body is only `page_size` (1–100) and a UUID `start_cursor`: no filter, no sort (an empty body is refused, so `page_size` always goes). `links/sheets.js` (`OrosLinksSheets`, pure, Node-tested in `tests/linksnotiondb.test.js`): `searchReq/readSearch` (databases, the title property first then the rest as Notion lists them, ≤ 64 columns; trash and odd ids out), `queryReq/readRows`, `valueOf` (title/rich text plain; number; select, status; multi-select and people and files joined with ", "; date `YYYY-MM-DD[ HH:MM]` with ` → ` for a range; checkbox `TRUE`/`FALSE`; url, email, phone; created/edited time and by; relation = the count; unique id `PREFIX-n`; formula and rollup by their own type), `cell` (one line, ≤ 500 chars, a leading = + - @ gets an apostrophe: the same rule as BR-S1 `tableCell`), `table` (row 1 = names, ≤ 499 rows), `plan(st, got, ctx)` on `{ sheets: { id: values }, deleted }`: a database → sheet `L.extId(p, acct, "sheet", id)` named by its title (Excel-safe, ≤ 31), else the app's word; again: same unless `upd` (opt-in, OFF: the sheet's values become the database's, formats and name stay), a deleted sheet (Spreadsheet's `deleted[id]`) → skipped unless `revive`. `spreadsheet/platforms.js` (`OrosSheetPlatforms`): search by cursor (MAX 20 databases), then a queue of queries 5 per relay call with 1.7 s between calls, 5 pages per database. Spreadsheet: the `Notion` button next to CSV/XL (shell only); `platformApply` writes new sheets (row 1 bold) and replaced values (rawSet, keeping formats; extra cells deleted), `platformUndo` deletes the new sheets (tombstoned) and restores the old cells, through the shell notice's action.
- **Notion database → Kanban (wave 6F).** Same `notion` platform and the same two read-only requests as 6E (no relay change); apps ["notes", "spreadsheet", "kanban"]. `links/kanban.js` (needs `links/sheets.js` for `searchReq`, `queryReq`, `readSearch`, `valueOf`): `listReq("notion", n, cursor)`, `readList` → items `{ id, name, props }` (the database's schema, kept for the board) with `next`, `boardReq("notion", id, n, cursor)`, `readRows`, `toExport("notion", id, { db, rows }, names)` → a Trello-export-shaped board `nt-<hex id>`: a list per option of the first `status` property (else first `select`; ids `-o-<option id>`; an option missing from the schema gets its own list), rows without a value in `-none` (named by the app; `Cards` when there is no grouping property), a row → card `nt<hex page id>` named by its title, first `date` start as due, first `multi_select` as labels (`-l-<option id>`, Notion colours mapped to Trello's names, brown → orange), every other non-empty property as "Name: value" lines in the notes plus the page's notion.so link; no checklists. Kanban's `accountSection` pages the list and the rows by cursor (MAX_PAGES 10 each) and lands the board through `trelloAdapter` and the idempotent merge, like Trello and GitHub.
- **Newsletter shops (editor wave E4).** WooCommerce apps now ["stock", "newsletter"]; its allowlist adds GET `/customers` (page, per_page, orderby, order, role=customer|all), GET `/data/currencies/current`, and product pictures: `{m:"GET", path:"/wp-content/uploads/…(.jpg|.jpeg|.png|.gif|.webp)", img:1}` (path from the site address, no query, only non-ASCII %XX escapes, no `..`; `checkImg`), sent only through the relay (`orosLinks.call` sends a call of picture requests straight to `viaRelay`, without the keys reaching the shop: the relay fetches it without Authorization and answers `{status, type, b64}`), used when the shop doesn't let the browser read its pictures. New platform `shopify` (`site: true`, the address is always the shop's root; root `/api/2025-10`; key = the public Storefront access token, 32 hex, header `X-Shopify-Storefront-Access-Token`; apps ["newsletter"]; `direct: true` = never through the relay, which doesn't know it): one rule, POST `/graphql.json` with `query` exactly one of `L.SHOPIFY_Q` (shop, products, nodes; compared as text like the Odoo bodies) and `variables` only `first` 1–50, `after` (cursor), `query` (search ≤ 100, no control characters), `ids` (1–20 Product gids); `sfq`: products need `first` and no ids, nodes only `ids`, shop no variables. Settings: Shopify tile in the shop group (monogram "Sh").
