### Opening files from the device: "Open with" → an app (BR-FILE-OPEN)
- **BR-FO-1 · Where.** Chrome / Edge with orOS installed (Windows, Linux, macOS). `manifest.webmanifest` `file_handlers` (one per app, action `/?file-open=<app>`) put orOS into the system's "Open with"; the browser asks once per type before the first launch and hands the files to `window.launchQueue`. Not in Firefox or Safari; not on Android for an installed web app (Android files come in later through the Share target or the store package). Only the person can make orOS the *default* (system settings); Settings › Opening files says how. No `launch_handler` (Dropbox OAuth, see "Send to orOS").
- **BR-FO-2 · One table.** `fileopen.js` `HANDLERS` (app → MIME → extensions) is the source; the manifest is built from it with `manifestHandlers()`, which puts each extension into its first app only (one "Open with" entry per type). `tests/fileopen.test.js` keeps the two equal. Only types an app already imports are listed; PDF, pictures, audio/video, .html, .json, .zip are not taken over on purpose. Pad (4.81.00) takes the code and config types no other app reads (.py .sh .c/.cpp/.h .java .kt .cs .go .rs .ts/.tsx/.jsx .css/.scss .xml .yaml .toml .ini/.cfg/.conf .sql .lua .rb .pl .php .swift .dart .r .diff/.patch .log .jsfx/.eel …) and is one more choice for .txt / .md after Writer, Mind Map, Notes (and Text Tools for .txt). `.ics` → Calendar and `.vcf` → Contacts go through BR-FILE-IMPORT (owned by those apps): the table marks them `text: "importIcs"|"importVcf"`, the shell refuses over 5 MB, reads `file.text()` and calls `__orosOpenAt("calendar", {importIcs:{name,text}})` / `__orosOpenAt("contacts", {importVcf:{name,text}})` (no token).
- **BR-FO-3 · Choosing the app.** The person's choice for the type (localStorage `oros-file-open` `{ver:1, map:{".txt":"writer"|"ask"}}`, this device only, never synced), else the only app, else a chooser dialog in the shell ("Always use this app" saves the choice). One file per launch (more → the first, with a notice); > 50 MB refused.
- **BR-FO-4 · Handover.** A File cannot ride the JSON deep link, so the shell keeps it under a random one-shot token (10 min) and calls `__orosOpenAt(app, { openFile: { token, name, size } })`; the app takes it once with `window.parent.__orosTakeFile(token)` and runs the same import as its own Import / Open button (same size caps and sanitisers, new item or the app's own preview/confirm; nothing overwritten). Nothing is ever written back to the original file. Receivers: Writer (`ioOpenFile` → import dialog), Spreadsheet (`xlImport` / `csvImport`), Atelier (`AT.io.openFile`), Slides (`SL.io.openFile`), Layout (`LY.io.openFile`), Reader / Podcasts (`opmlFromFile`), Mind Map (`importFromFile`), Family Tree (`gedcomFromFile`), Ringtone Composer (`readImport`), Notes (`openFileTarget`).
- **BR-FO-5 · Boot.** `fileopen.js` loads before `shell.js`, strips `?file-open=` from the address bar at once and waits for `orosFileOpen.ready()` (called after `apps.json` loads). `sw.js` never caches `?file-open=` navigations.
- **BR-FO-6 · Android Share → orOS (files).** `share_target` is POST `multipart/form-data` to `/?share-target` (params title/text/url + `files`, accept = every MIME type and extension of the table, `fileopen.js` `shareTarget()`, test-checked against the manifest). `sw.js` `shareTargetPost` answers it: no file → 303 to `/?share-url=&share-title=&share-text=&share-pick=1` (AS-OUT: the "Send to…" sheet; a single app's page gets no `share-pick`); a file → the first one into Cache Storage `oros-share-inbox` at `/__share/<random id>` (name in `X-Name`, `X-More: 1` when there were more), 303 to `/?share-files=<id>`; > 50 MB → `/?share-files=big`. `fileopen.js` strips the param, reads the entry once, deletes the inbox, and the file goes the same way as an "Open with" file (BR-FO-3/4). Notices wait for `ready()`. The inbox survives SW activation (kept list). Needs the SW in control (always true for the installed app).
- **BR-FO-7 · Notes.** .txt / .md also open in Notes (chooser with Writer and Mind Map): a new top-level page titled after the file, text as is, ≤ 200 000 characters.
- **BR-FO-8 · Text Tools (1.18.00).** Takes .txt (after Writer, Mind Map, Notes), .csv (after Spreadsheet, so a chooser) and .tsv (only app; manifest file_handler `/?file-open=texttools`).
- **BR-FO-9 · Inside orOS: Files (app interop wave 2, 2026-10-17).** Files opens a file of the orOS disk in an app with the same table, choice and chooser: `orosFileOpen.insideFor(ext)` = the table's apps + `INSIDE` (types only Files opens, never in the manifest: songs → Music) and `orosFileOpen.openInside(file, ask)` (`chooseInside`: saved choice → only app → chooser; `ask` always asks when several apps read it). Files reads the blob, makes a `File` and hands it over as BR-FO-4; `openInside` first copies it into a shell-made `File` (`ownFile`), because a `File` made in Files' frame cannot be read once the app replaces that frame (fix 2026-10-17: Photo Lab stayed on its home screen). Double click / second tap opens in the app only what the preview cannot show (not text, pictures or zip); the preview gets `Open in {app}` / `Open with…` (`#pv-open`), the item menu `Open with…`. Music: a song under `/internal/Music/` goes as `{ playPath }` (played after a rescan; a second scan when the boot scan was already running); any other song as `{ openFile }`, copied into the music folder (`LIB.addFiles` returns `paths`) and played. Files' `Send to an app…` sends the selected files (≤ 10) as BR-SEND kind `files` `{ items: [{ path, name }] }` (paths `/internal/…` only, Mail's `diskPath` rule) → Mail `{ compose: { subject, attach } }`. Tests `tests/interop-files.test.js`. A table or `INSIDE` entry may name `path: "openPath"`: Files then hands that app the disk path instead of a copy (`openInside(file, ask, path)` → `openWith(app, file, path)` → `__orosOpenAt(app, {openPath})`), so it saves in place. Pad is the first (4.81.00); its INSIDE entry adds .js .mjs .cjs .json .jsonc .webmanifest .html .htm .xhtml .vue .svelte, which stay out of the manifest.

### orOS file format (OBF 1.0, `bundle.js`)
Decided by Chris 2026-10-15 (thread "Ανοιχτά φορμά για κάθε εφαρμογή"): every app that makes a project saves it as its own open file; plan and decisions /mnt/project-files/oros-formats/oros-bundle-spec.md; public spec `docs/oros-bundle.md`.
- **OBF-1 · Container.** A ZIP: `mimetype` first and stored (`application/x-oros-<word>`), `META-INF/manifest.xml` (every file with type, size, sha256; `version`, `app`, `schema` = `<app>/<n>`, `min-reader`), `meta.xml` (Dublin Core title/creator/language/date/subject + created, generator, id), `content.json` (the app's own model, JSON: decided 12:47), optional `settings.json`, `media/<key>`, `preview/thumbnail.png` + portable copies, `README.txt` (EN + EL). Text deflated, media stored. Never encrypted (Chris 12:32: no zip password, no local encryption). No ZIP64 yet.
- **OBF-2 · Kit.** Root `bundle.js` (`window.OrosBundle`, pure apart from `pickFolder()`): `write`, `read`, `readFolder`, `sniff`, `sha256`, `typeOf`, `safePath`, `TYPES`. Own ZIP writer (deflate through `CompressionStream`) and reader (does not use atelier/zip.js, whose 80 MB entry cap is below Atelier's clips). Node-tested in `tests/bundle.test.js`.
- **OBF-3 · Hostile files.** Refused: wrong/missing first `mimetype`, bad paths (absolute, `..`, `\`, `:`, non-ASCII, > 200), duplicates, encrypted entries, > 10 000 entries, > 512 MB per entry or 1 GB total inflated, ratio > 1000:1, inflation past the declared size, any `<!`/`<?` in the XML besides the declaration, newer major version (`imp.newer` / `io.newer` message). Hash mismatches are reported (`changed`), not refused; a hash-named media file whose bytes changed is re-keyed to its real sha256 and content.json follows. Media types from the bytes. content.json always goes through the app's own normaliser/sanitiser; nothing from a bundle runs.
- **OBF-4 · Apps (phase 1).** Writer `.orosdoc` (pictures lifted from data: URLs into `media/`, `src="media/<key>"` in content.json, `preview/document.html` with `../media/`; no thumbnail: Writer has no page renderer), Slides `.orosslides`, Atelier `.orosdesign`, Layout `.oroslayout` (thumbnail of the first page/slide, 512 px; Layout only for the open document). MIME types and extensions unchanged, so "Open with" (BR-FO) needs no change. Old JSON files open forever (first bytes not `PK`). Every app has "Open unzipped folder" next to its Open/Import (`OrosBundle.pickFolder` → `readFolder`; the folder holding `mimetype` is the root, approved by Chris 12:35).
- **OBF-4b · Apps (phase 2).** Spreadsheet `.orossheet` (whole workbook; opening ADDS the sheets, renamed "X (2)" on a clash with formulas rewritten; CSV per sheet + thumbnail), Mind map `.orosmind` (one map; thumbnail + `map.md`/`map.opml`), Notes `.orosnotes` (one notebook, `notes/package.js`; a plain .zip without `mimetype` still goes to the Obsidian/zip import), Wiki `.oroswiki` (one wiki WITH its revision history; picture keys = the wiki's sha256 asset ids), Kanban `.orosboard` (one board + attachments), Prompter `.orosscript` (one custom prompt + star/done; `prompter/io.js`), Ringtones `.orostone` (one melody; `.rtttl` + `.wav` preview up to 60 s). New "Open with" receivers: Wiki, Kanban, Prompter (fileopen.js HANDLERS + manifests). Every app: new item with fresh ids, its own normaliser, "Unzipped orOS folder…", `newer` → "update orOS". Contents per app in docs/oros-bundle.md.
- **OBF-6 · Big projects (phase 3).** `writeBlob(opts)` → Blob of headers + the media Blobs themselves (never copied); `read(File, {big: true, onProgress})` reads a piece at a time and returns `media[key].blob` (slice of the file) + `bytes` only ≤ 64 MB; `digest(bytes|Blob)` = SHA-256 + CRC-32 in 4 MB pieces (JS SHA-256, ~65 MB/s in Chromium). Big mode: stored media ≤ 16 GB each / 64 GB total; deflated entries stay ≤ 512 MB. ZIP64 (records + extra fields) only when an entry/offset passes 4 GB or > 65 535 entries; smaller bundles are byte-identical to 1.0. New types: Studio `.orosstudio`, Montage `.orosmontage`, Photo Lab `.orosphoto`, Pixel `.orospixel`; new "Open with" receivers Studio and Pixel. Tests `tests/bundle-big.test.js` (lowered ZIP64 thresholds via `_z64`, checked by Python zipfile).
- **OBF-4c · Apps (phase 3).** Studio `.orosstudio` (`studio/package.js`; audio + IR files streamed from /internal/Studio as media, ids/sidechains/automation lanes renewed; `song.mid` + timeline thumbnail), Montage `.orosmontage` (`montage/package.js`; media keys = the app's own `<sha256>.<ext>` ids, written back with `MontageMedia.putById`, skipped when already on the device; poster, `timeline.txt`, `captions.srt`; also fixed "Open with" of .mp4/.webm/.mov: the parent window's File is wrapped before Mediabunny), Photo Lab `.orosphoto` (`photolab/package.js`, own lossless PNG writer/reader so semi-transparent pixels survive exactly; one PNG per raster layer/mask/selection; flattened `preview/image.png`), Pixel `.orospixel` (one face recipe; PNG + SVG). Montage/Studio/Photo Lab use `writeBlob` + `read(file, {big:true})` with progress.
- **OBF-4d · Apps (phase 4a).** Family tree `.orostree` (one tree; photos as media, `preview/tree.ged` + chart thumbnail), Certificates `.oroscert` (`certificates/package.js`; one event + its people, design pictures by the design kit's ids, signing keys NEVER written, a device signs new codes with its own key), Label Maker `.oroslabels` (the sheet Print would print + copies; first import/export the app has), Travel `.orostrip` (`travel/package.js`; one trip with tickets and journal photos from /internal/Travel, pictures re-saved as JPEG without EXIF, PDFs must start `%PDF-`; `trip.md`/`.ics`/`.gpx`), Maps `.orosmap` (`maps/package.js` + `package-ui.js`; a picker of place groups and tracks; places already on the device are skipped, groups clash → "Name (2)", tracks pass the strict GPX reader; never tiles, OSM tokens or notes). New "Open with" receivers: Certificates, Label Maker, Travel. Each open makes new items with fresh ids and has Undo where the app has it.
- **OBF-4e · Record apps (phase 4b).** Each record app saves ALL its records as its own `.oros<word>` file (Chris 12:38): 33 types registered at once (bundle.js TYPES, fileopen.js HANDLERS, root + single-app manifests): `.orostasks` To-Do, `.oroshabits`, `.oroswater`, `.oroschores`, `.orosscores`, `.oroscycle`, `.orosmood`, `.oroscal` Calendar, `.oroscontacts`, `.orosbookmarks`, `.orosfeeds`, `.orospodcasts`, `.orosmeals`, `.orosstickies`, `.orosbudget`, `.orosinvoices`, `.oroscrm`, `.oroshours` Timesheet, `.orosquote`, `.orossplit`, `.orosstock`, `.orosdiary`, `.oroshealth`, `.orosworkouts` Fitness, `.orosbaby`, `.orospet` Pet care, `.orosplants`, `.orosgarage`, `.oroslibrary` (no book files), `.orosshelf`, `.orossignature`, `.orosnewsletter`, `.orosinventory` Storage. content.json `{ kind: "oros-<app>-package", ver: 1, data }` = the sync slice without tombstones and device-only fields. Shared kit root `recordpkg.js` (`window.OrosRecordPkg`: `pack`, `open`, `ui`; pure, `tests/recordpkg.test.js`). **Opening = add-only merge** (amends OBF-4's "never overwrites": a record app adds the records it lacks WITH their ids, never overwrites or deletes by default): reopening a file adds nothing; an id already here (live or deleted) is kept; optional "Update with newer versions" takes a newer copy of a live record; tombstones in a file are ignored; stamps clamped to now + 5 min; the result goes through the app's own merge/save, never `orosSync.importData`; confirm dialog with counts, Undo through the app's own delete. Save says in one line that the file is not encrypted. Calendar/Contacts keep .ics/.vcf as text (`textExt`), their bundles go as Files. Quote and Meals also get "Open as copy" (fresh ids). Left out: Passwords, Assistant, Mail, config apps, games, Radio/TV favourites, counters. Pilot: To-Do (`todo/package.js`). Wave 1 (2.49.00): To-Do, Habits, Water, Chore Wheel, Score Keeper, Cycle, Mood (`<app>/package.js`, precached); a day already logged on the device keeps its values; same-name symptoms/places are folded into the device's own (Cycle, Mood). Wave 2 (2.52.00): Calendar, Contacts (no photos, nothing from account imports), Bookmarks, Reader, Podcasts (never the gpodder key), Meal Planner (+ Open as copy), Sticky Notes (screen positions stay on the device; shell loads `stickies/host.js`); fileopen.js `extOf` accepts extensions up to 24 characters. Wave 3 (2.55.00): business apps CRM `.oroscrm`, Quote Builder `.orosquote` (+ Open as copy), Timesheet `.oroshours`, Stock `.orosstock`, Budget `.orosbudget`, Invoices `.orosinvoices`, Split `.orossplit`; media (receipts, product photos, invoice PDFs, scans) in `media/`, never provider keys or tokens, bank profiles, a running timer or device-only settings. Wave 4 (2.58.00): health and home apps Diary `.orosdiary`, Health `.oroshealth`, Workouts `.orosworkouts`, Baby `.orosbaby`, Pet Health Book `.orospet`, Plant Care `.orosplants`, Garage `.orosgarage`; reminders come in turned off, media in `media/`, never the Pl@ntNet key, a running workout or timer, Health settings or Medical ID; Save says the file is not encrypted. Wave 5 (2.61.00): Library `.oroslibrary`, Media Shelf `.orosshelf`, Email Signature `.orossignature`, Newsletter `.orosnewsletter` (never sends; issues as drafts, feeds off), Storage `.orosinventory`; never keys, salts, SMTP users, send state, suppressions, reminders or book files. Phase 4b COMPLETE: all 33 record apps have their own file (`PENDING_4B` empty).
- **OBF-4f · Flashcards (Flashcards wave 5, 2026-10-17).** `.oroscards` (`application/x-oros-cards`, `flashcards/package.js` FlashcardsPackage, pure): content.json `{kind: "oros-flashcards-package", ver: 1, at, decks, notes, reviews}` for all decks or one deck and its sub-decks (the chosen deck becomes top level), answers only when "Include my study history" is ticked, `media/<sha256>.<ext>` = the pictures and sounds the notes use, `preview/cards.csv`. Opening ADDS only (no data loss, opening twice adds nothing): notes missing here by id (a note deleted here comes back as a new version; stamps from the future clamped to now + 5 min), answer/undo/flag rows missing here by id, decks missing here by id when they get a new note or hold none in the file; every picture is redrawn and every sound re-hashed by `media.js` before it is written. Receiver Flashcards (fileopen.js HANDLERS + manifest). Converter: `.apkg`/`.colpkg` → `.oroscards` (`flashcards/convert.js`). Tests `tests/flashcards-stats.test.js`.
- **OBF-7 · orOS Converter (approved by Chris 2026-10-15 15:00).** New Office app `converter/` turns other files into orOS files in bulk, and Files has "Convert to orOS" for the files it can take. Wave 1: Writer (.docx .odt .rtf .html .htm .md .markdown .txt → `.orosdoc`) and Spreadsheet (.xlsx .xls .ods .csv → `.orossheet`). ### Invoices PDF import (Novus / timologisi.online)
- `invoices/pdfin.js` (UMD `OrosInvoicesPdfIn`): pure `parse(items)` reads the text items of a PDF (PDF.js `getTextContent`, `isEvalSupported:false`, `enableXfa:false`; ≤ 5 pages, ≤ 50 files of ≤ 10 MB per import) by label and position: kind / series / number / date under "ΕΙΔΟΣ ΠΑΡΑΣΤΑΤΙΚΟΥ", the client's labelled fields (ΕΠΩΝΥΜΙΑ, ΕΠΑΓΓΕΛΜΑ, ΔΙΕΥΘΥΝΣΗ, ΠΟΛΗ / Τ.Κ., ΤΗΛ / ΕΜΑΙΛ, ΑΦΜ / ΔΟΥ) left of the right-hand block, the lines between "ΠΕΡΙΓΡΑΦΗ" and "ΑΝΑΛΥΣΗ ΦΠΑ", the totals (rightmost label with an amount on its line: ΚΑΘΑΡΗ ΑΞΙΑ, ΦΠΑ, ΤΕΛΙΚΗ ΑΞΙΑ, ΚΡΑΤΗΣΕΙΣ, ΠΛΗΡΩΤΕΟ) and the foot line "UID ΜΑΡΚ code" (else "ΜΑΡΚ: n" anywhere). Checks: net + VAT = total, total − deductions = payable, lines = net; a row with a warning is not ticked by default.
- `plan(data, list, opts)` (pure) decides per file: `new` (issuer ΑΦΜ is one of yours, prof + profs; none set → taken as yours), `bill` (the client ΑΦΜ is yours → received invoice), `have` (same id, same ΜΑΡΚ, or an `ext` with the same number + date + client ΑΦΜ), `credit` and `bad` (→ "Record by hand": the ext editor prefilled, the PDF attached), `other`. Client: `matchClient` by ΑΦΜ / name, else a new one linked to the CRM partner with the same ΑΦΜ (`customersForBilling`). Due = date + `prof.days` (30); "Μετρητά" / "Κάρτα" → a payment of the payable amount on the date. Withholding % = deductions / net.
- Write: the PDFs go to `/internal/Invoices/<num>-<date>.pdf` (`orosFS.write`; a failed copy only means no file), then one save. Entry points: New › "Import invoice PDFs" (a multiple file input) and PDFs dropped on the app. Nothing from a file is run or used as HTML (`textContent` only), every record passes `normDoc` / `normClient` / `normBill` / `normPay`.
- Not covered: credit notes and scans (by hand), the timologisi.online API import (needs the person's own key; deferred).

Never stored, micro-cached ~1 s.
